verdict: Meta is delivering leads efficiently; Google tracking is being fixed now.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 138 leads at a cost of $15.85 per lead, driven entirely by Meta — and leads are up 8.33% week over week with cost per lead holding steady. Google Ads spent $507 over the same period and recorded zero conversions; this is a confirmed attribution issue, not an ad performance issue, and conversion tracking repair is underway with offline import set to go live by September 30. Your Google Business Profile generated 41 direction actions this period but logged zero calls and zero website clicks, which points to a listing or tracking misconfiguration that is being investigated and corrected. Inside your CRM, 131 opportunities were created this period but none have moved to won and no appointments are recorded, meaning leads are arriving but stalling in the pipeline — that intake flow is being reviewed. Next period, expect Google to begin reporting measurable results once attribution is restored, and pipeline movement to improve as the intake gaps are closed.

cost per lead on Meta, stable week over week
